label: zone-stockpile-dumping-filter

Z1.details: Self-bootstrap + GameSceneGate.RunWhenGameScene gate, O hotkey, mutual-exclusion with build/decon/mine/grow, ESC/right-click cancel, idempotent re-mark, IsFloorCell reject water/rock/occupied. Spawns StockpileZoneEntity per cell (Normal, All). Runtime 1x1 white marker sprite (priority tint via StockpileZoneEntity.ApplyTint).

Z2.what: Coarse allowed-items filter + hauler honors it.
Z2.details: [Flags] StockItemKind {Wood,Stone,Food,All}; allowedKinds field (default All, back-compat); Accepts(kind); ToggleKind (last-one-on guard); SetAllowedKinds; FindBest(from,kind) overload skips non-accepting zones, old FindBest(from)=FindBest(from,All). Hauler: wood drop -> FindBest(.,Wood), food -> .Food, stone -> .Stone, blueprint-fallback -> CarriedKind() OR-merge.

Z2b.details: Left-click an existing stockpile (when no designation mode active, not over UI) -> floating 3-button toolbar 🪵🪨🍖 on first Canvas, follows zone in screen space. Lit=allowed/dim=forbidden, click toggles StockpileZoneEntity.ToggleKind -> hauler Z2 filter respects immediately. Buttons fill.raycastTarget=true.

Z3.what: Dumping zone preset = Low priority + Stone-only.
Z3.details: StockpileDesignation.SetDumpingMode(true) lays Spawn(Low, Stone). Low priority grey tint reads as refuse. Wood/food prefer normal zones (Z2 filter), chunks/stone accepted. No separate entity class.

items.Z4: DEFERRED per spec — single crop type, crop-selection invisible. Untouched.

bug_firewall.#4_audio_buzz: PlaySelect 1x per new cell / 1x per toggle click (AudioBank internal throttle); idempotent re-mark silent.
bug_firewall.#7_singleton_race: No OnEnable subscribe; poll-find managers each frame.
bug_firewall.#9_runInBackground: No WaitForSeconds heartbeat; all timing via Time.unscaledTime in Update.
bug_firewall.GameSceneGate: New ~StockpileDesignation gated via GameSceneGate.RunWhenGameScene (no MainMenu leak).

lane_discipline.ArchitectMenu: Zone (구역) category: added 저장/폐기 OrderItem only. No other category/struct/settings change.
lane_discipline.note: Lane named AI/PawnHauler.cs; actual file is Scripts/PawnHauler.cs (no AI-subfolder duplicate) — edited that.

compile_check: brace/paren balanced on all 4 files; Unity batchmode compile not run (QA owns).

Architect->Zone->폐기, drag -> Low (grey) Stone-only zones; wood/food prefer normal zone, stone goes to dump.
